description: This file defines the ZoneShapes class which provides methods for rendering and grouping display shapes within OrchardCore's display management zones, including handling of tabs, cards, columns, and positional grouping logic.

classes.name: PositionalGrouping
classes.description: A helper class implementing IPositioned to represent positional groupings based on shape metadata.

methods.name: Zone
methods.description: Renders a zone by executing shapes asynchronously and concatenating their HTML content.

methods.name: ContentZone
methods.description: Handles rendering of content zones with grouping logic for tabs, cards, and columns based on shape metadata.

methods.name: CardGrouping
methods.description: Renders grouped shapes as card containers or columns depending on grouping metadata.

methods.name: ColumnGrouping
methods.description: Renders shapes grouped into columns with specific classes and modifiers, including position and size adjustments.

methods.name: GetColumnPositions
methods.description: Extracts position modifiers from shape metadata for columns.

methods.name: GetColumnModifiers
methods.description: Extracts column size modifiers from shape metadata.

methods.name: FirstGroupingWithModifierOrDefault
methods.description: Finds the first shape in a grouping that contains a specific metadata modifier character.
